run_record_evaluation: run the ReCoRD evaluation script with a dataset JSON file and predictions JSON file
test_f1_score: test the f1_score function that computes token-level F1 between prediction and ground truth
test_exact_match_score: test the exact_match_score function that checks normalized answer equality
test_evaluate: test the evaluate function that computes exact_match and f1 metrics over a ReCoRD dataset
test_normalize_answer: test the normalize_answer function that lowercases, removes punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
